why: No major reviewer or authority answers the mixed Windows+Mac home backup question with testing: Tom's Guide is a mini PC page, Macworld is a Mac-only general guide, PCMag is unreadable. The only pages answering it are ChooseCompute (two niche research pages with priced builds, no hands-on testing) and an affiliate Time Machine listicle with unverifiable testing claims; the rest are Newegg buying guides, Amazon-copy roundups and a small-business page. A focused page comparing backup software for PCs and Macs with current prices and a direct pick would stand out.
